name: Bold-Line Field Explainer
description: Simple stick figures in dense, flat-coloured places, with smooth black outlines and explanatory devices built into the scene.
style_bible: A drawn explainer that puts a very simple figure inside a very detailed, fully coloured place. Line: every shape is closed by one smooth black contour of even weight — the same weight on the figure, a prop, a leaf and the far canopy — with confident curves, no sketchiness, no hatching, no double lines. Fill: every surface is one flat colour; no shading, no cel step, no cast shadow, no texture, no highlight. Depth comes only from value steps of a single hue plus a light, soft sky wash behind the far foliage. Palette: each frame commits to one dominant family — deep jungle green through four or five values with bark brown, a tan path and a cream sky; or a cool grey interior with exactly one warm accent — and stays saturated without neon. Environment: dense and layered, filling the frame edge to edge in three or four value bands, lighter and cooler as they recede, so the near plane is the most saturated. Figures: a person is a white round head, two black dot eyes with small pupils, at most a thin brow or curved mouth when the idea needs it, thin black stick arms and legs with dot or mitten hands, and simple flat clothing blocks. Figures stand low in a level composition, so the density around them does the work. Props: flat outlines with one or two flat fills each. Devices: explanatory marks are objects in the scene, not overlays — a framed map inset with a dashed boundary, a signboard, a chart on an easel, a split frame with map on one side and the real place on the other. Lighting: none stated; every value is flat. Keep the contract content-independent: no fixed character, place, era, brand or copied composition.
